title: Implement install-workguard Applications LaunchAgent flow
description:
Implement OpenSpec change install-workguard-applications-launchagent: make bash rebuild.sh the sole supported install/rebuild entrypoint, install /Applications/WorkGuard.app with stable com.agaibadulin.workguard bundle id, generate/reload com.agaibadulin.workguard LaunchAgent, keep direct Python debug-only, preserve local-only privacy and ActivitySignals future-boundary constraints.

CHILDREN
  ↳ ○ work_guard-ofl.1: 1.1 Create `packaging/` and move WorkGuard app bundle templates/assets into packaging-only ownership. ● P1
  ↳ ○ work_guard-ofl.10: 3.4 Install Python dependencies from `requirements.txt` through the `workguard` environment during rebuild. ● P1
  ↳ ○ work_guard-ofl.11: 3.5 Generate the installed app launcher from `packaging/` templates using the resolved interpreter path and source-root-relative `work_guard.py` path. ● P1
  ↳ ○ work_guard-ofl.12: 3.6 Build the optional Swift menu binary when `swiftc` and `WorkGuardMenu/main.swift` are available; otherwise print a clear warning and preserve fallback behavior. ● P1
  ↳ ○ work_guard-ofl.13: 4.1 Call `scripts/stop_workguard.sh` from `rebuild.sh` before replacing app or LaunchAgent state. ● P1
  ↳ ○ work_guard-ofl.14: 4.2 Abort `rebuild.sh` on any non-zero `scripts/stop_workguard.sh` exit before touching `/Applications/WorkGuard.app` or the LaunchAgent plist. ● P1
  ↳ ○ work_guard-ofl.15: 4.3 Unregister the previous `/Applications/WorkGuard.app` with `lsregister -u` when it exists. ● P1
## Success Criteria
- [ ] Complete
